title: Correct normal force
description: Essential: The student must state that the normal force on m2 is 40 N (or equivalent).

title: Correct frictional force
description: Essential: The student must state that the frictional force on m2 is 10√3 N (or equivalent).

title: Correct pulley tension magnitude
description: Essential: The student must state that the tension in string OA is 20√3 N (or equivalent).

title: Correct pulley tension direction
description: Essential: The student must state the direction of the OA tension (e.g., 30° to the vertical, upper left).

title: Tension in connecting rope
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the rope tension as equal to m1*g (20 N).

title: Force balance on m2
description: Important: The solution must apply vertical and horizontal equilibrium equations to block m2.

title: Vector addition for pulley
description: Important: The solution must correctly combine the two rope tensions on the pulley to find the net force from OA.

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly adds the vertical tension component to the weight when calculating the normal force.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the wrong angle (e.g., 60° instead of 30°) in trigonometric functions for force components.

title: Free-body diagram clarity
description: Optional: Award credit if the solution includes clear free-body diagrams for m2 and/or the pulley.
